meta.name: Manufacturing Consent
meta.description: Manufacturing Consent — Noam Chomsky and the Mediaexplores the political life and ideas of Noam Chomsky, the renowned American linguist and political activist. Drawing on specific examples such as the corporate media coverage of the Indonesian occupation of East Timor and the atrocities of the Khmer Rouge regime of Cambodia,Manufacturing Consentshows how the collusion of government and media running the powerful propaganda machines that manipulate the opinions of the masses, is manufacturing consent.
